sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 11 OF 1991
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 11 OF 1991
JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (THIRD
AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1991
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
25th November, 1991]
No. F. 2(2)/91-Pub, dated 25-11-1991.----The following Order made by the President is
hereby published for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Supreme Court Judges
(Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1968 (P.O. No.1 of 1968), and the High
Colin Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1970 (P.O. No. 9 of 1970),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing:
Now, Therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by the Fifth
Schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan the President
is pleased to make the following Order:-
1. Short title and commencement:-----(1) This Order may be called the Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges)
(Third Amendment) Order, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken
effect on the first day of June, 1991.
2. Amendment of paragraph 22-BB, P.O. No.1 of 1968:-----In the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension
and Privileges) Order, 1968 (P.O. No. 1 of 1968), in paragraph 22-BB.
(a) for the words "one thousand three hundred and seventy-five
rupees" the words "three thousand and six hundred rupees" shall
be substituted; and
(b) for the words "one thousand two hundred and seventy-five
rupees" the words "three thousand and five hundred rupees" shall
be substituted.
3. Amendment of paragraph 22-BB, P.O. No.9 of 1970:-----In the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1970 (P.O. No. 9 of 1970), in paragraph 22-BB.
(a) for the words "one thousand two hundred and fifty rupees"
the words "three thousand and five hundred rupees" shall be
substituted; and
(b) for the words "one thousand rupees" the words "three
thousand rupees" shall be substituted.
